goal: Map each requirement to the code and tests that meet it, and flag the code flaws found on the way.
use: Map each requirement to the code and tests that meet it, and flag the code flaws found on the way. Use when a feature must be checked against its requirements before release.

steps.note: Read the requirements. Take the requirements as written, numbered.
Map to code. For each requirement, find the code and the tests that meet it.
Mark each requirement. Met (code and test), partly met (code but no test, or a gap), or not met (no code).
Find code flaws. While mapping, note flaws in the code that the requirement depends on: missing validation, unhandled errors, unclear behaviour and missing edge cases.
Check the edge cases. For each met requirement, list the edge cases it implies (empty input, limits, failure of a dependency) and whether each one is handled.
Report. A table: requirement, status, code location, test location, flaws found, fix.

protocol.title: Read the requirements
protocol.text: Take the requirements as written, numbered. If a requirement is vague, record it as vague rather than guessing its meaning.

protocol.title: Map to code
protocol.text: For each requirement, find the code and the tests that meet it. Record `file:line` for each.

protocol.title: Mark each requirement
protocol.text: Met (code and test), partly met (code but no test, or a gap), or not met (no code).

protocol.title: Find code flaws
protocol.text: While mapping, note flaws in the code that the requirement depends on: missing validation, unhandled errors, unclear behaviour and missing edge cases.

protocol.title: Check the edge cases
protocol.text: For each met requirement, list the edge cases it implies (empty input, limits, failure of a dependency) and whether each one is handled.

protocol.title: Report
protocol.text: A table: requirement, status, code location, test location, flaws found, fix. Mark what you did not check and any requirement you had to read loosely.
